recognize_zh: H&E 可見淋巴濾泡被同心圓排列的套區淋巴球包圍（洋蔥皮樣，onion skinning）；免疫染色中散在的漿母細胞呈 HHV-8 點狀核染色、胞質 IgM 強陽性並 lambda 限制，符合 HHV-8 相關多中心 Castleman 病。
features: Regressed follicle with a broad mantle zone of small lymphocytes in concentric onion-skin layers
Hyalinized penetrating vessels within the follicle center
CD20 highlights the follicle and scattered B cells
HHV-8 (LANA-1) shows scattered nuclear-positive cells mainly within the mantle zone
Scattered large cells with strong cytoplasmic IgM staining in the mantle zone
Lambda-positive large cells with essentially negative kappa staining, indicating lambda restriction
describe_en: Lymph node excision (A, H&E) shows a regressed follicle surrounded by an expanded mantle zone of small lymphocytes arranged in concentric layers, with hyalinized vessels penetrating the follicle. CD20 (B) highlights the follicular B-cell compartment. HHV-8 LANA-1 immunostain (C) shows scattered nuclear-positive cells, predominantly within the mantle zone. These cells show strong cytoplasmic IgM (D) and lambda light chain (E) expression, with kappa (F) essentially negative. Findings are consistent with HHV-8-associated multicentric Castleman disease with IgM lambda plasmablasts.

ddx.vs: iMCD can show similar follicular changes but the LANA-1 immunostain is negative and there are no IgM lambda plasmablasts.

ddx.dx: HHV-8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV-8+ DLBCL forms confluent sheets of IgM lambda plasmablasts effacing architecture rather than scattered cells within mantle zones.
Unicentric disease shows similar onion-skin mantles and lollipop vessels but lacks HHV-8-positive plasmablasts and systemic inflammatory symptoms.
Kaposi sarcoma shows HHV-8-positive spindle cells forming slit-like vascular spaces rather than LANA-positive plasmablasts in mantle zones.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, HHV-8 LANA-1, IgM, lambda, kappa
